CVE-2026-112057.title: libdvdnav before 7.0.0 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnera ...
CVE-2026-112057.description: libdvdnav before 7.0.0 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in dvdnav_describe_title_chapters that allows attackers to read beyond the part-of-title array by supplying an oversized vts_ttn value. Attackers can provide a crafted DVD or disc image declaring a larger VMGI title vts_ttn than the title set's entries to crash applications enumerating chapters.

CVE-2026-112058.title: VideoLAN libdvdnav through 7.0.0 contains an out-of-bounds read v ...
CVE-2026-112058.description: VideoLAN libdvdnav through 7.0.0 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in set_PTT that allows attackers to crash applications by supplying an invalid JumpTT title number checked only by an assert. Attackers can craft a DVD or disc image whose First Play program chain issues JumpTT with title 0 or an oversized number, reading past the heap title table and crashing the player.
